summary: Tested new leader dashboard buyers list + courtesy-earned card AND admin Overview 'Ingressos (por pessoa)' block. Wrote 5 pytest cases (all PASS): admin/stats has tickets_sold/pending/paid_only/courtesy ints with sold==paid_only+courtesy; non-leader gets 404 on /api/me/leader; leader empty state returns buyers=[] and courtesy=null; buyers array populates correctly with expected fields (holder_name, quantity, status, ticket_type_name, lot_name) and no _id leak; courtesy object populates when goal reached (courtesy_credential_issued=true + COURTESY order with courtesy_reason='Líder atingiu meta' + credential) — includes both order and credential without _id. UI test on production URL: admin Overview shows tickets-summary card with tickets-sold=23 and tickets-pending=0, and stat-tickets_sold card in the quick metrics grid; LeaderDashboard shows both leader-courtesy-card and leader-buyers-card with 2 buyer rows (data-testid=leader-buyer-{order_id}) and 'Ver minha credencial' navigates to /dashboard?highlight={credential_code}. Fixed one blocking bug: LeaderDashboard.jsx called api.get('/api/me/leader') but axios baseURL already includes /api → resulted in /api/api/me/leader 404 (same bug pattern as iteration 3/4). Replaced with '/me/leader'.

issues: React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' in Dashboard render method. Pre-existing, not introduced by this change but should be cleaned up.

buyers table in LeaderDashboard has good empty-state ('Ainda ninguém comprou pelo seu link...'), status badge styling per status, and pt-BR date formatting — no issues.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 features (leader buyers list, courtesy-earned card, admin ingressos summary) are fully working end-to-end. Only one code fix was needed (double /api prefix in LeaderDashboard.jsx). Pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_leader_and_stats.py can be reused as regression suite — it self-seeds and self-cleans.
rca of the issue: LeaderDashboard.jsx used api.get('/api/me/leader'). The shared axios instance in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js already sets baseURL = `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api`, so any relative path starting with '/api' produces a doubled prefix (/api/api/...) → 404. Symptom: LeaderDashboard would call load() → 404 → useEffect catch redirects to /dashboard, making the whole leader UI unreachable. Fix: change to '/me/leader'. Same bug family as iteration 3/4 fixes in AdminOrders.jsx.
